sloka: ननन्द दृष्ट्वा स च तान् सुरूपा ।न्नानागुणानात्मगुणानुरूपान् ।विद्योतमानान्स तदानुरूपान् ।ददर्श काम्श्चिच्च पुनर्विरूपान् ॥५-५-१६॥
transliteration: nananda dṛṣṭvā sa ca tān surūpā ।nnānāguṇānātmaguṇānurūpān ।vidyotamānānsa tadānurūpān ।dadarśa kāmścicca punarvirūpān ॥5-5-16॥

translations.english: He rejoiced to see the handsome demons radiant with forms commensurate with their virtues. He also saw some ugly figures, their traits in conformity to their forms.
